_comment: Run template for the lbnl-sdahu catalog entry. `camber datasets config lbnl-sdahu --store DIR --out cfg.json` fills in the store path. Hourly resample; every scenario is an equipment AHU__<scenario>, so one run scores them all. The design minimum OA is this unit's own: a fixed 10% damper position (inventory section 1.2) that measures as a 1.6% OA fraction (median of 119,163 occupied, fan-on minutes of the fault-free run) -- not a generic 20%. outdoor_air_fraction judges fan-on samples in the simulation's own occupied mode (SYS_CTL). The economizer runs between 33.8 F and 60 F with a fixed dry-bulb high limit (section 1.2), hence high_limit_f 60 without the differential changeover; the 33.8 F low-limit lockout is by design. LEAKING VALVE (0.98, #84), calibrated in-sample: the unit's fan adds a steady rise between the mixed-air and supply-air sensors, and the published 10% cooling-valve leak only cancels it (supply minus mixed air: median +1.06 F over 1,400 occupied, fan-on, valve-shut hours of the fault-free run; -0.1 F on coi_leakage_010), well inside the default 3 F margin, so the default rule misses it. measured_fan_heat_f 1.0 is that fault-free median (rounded); cool_delta_thr_f 1.0 puts the cooling-leak line at a rise below 0 F (below the mixed air); occupied_only judges the SYS_CTL occupied hours, since unoccupied fan cycling reads 24.2% below that line on the fault-free run against 2.4% occupied. The leak run then reads 60.5% (fault) and the damper runs under 2%. CIRCULARITY: the 1.0 F was calibrated on the fault-free run, and that run is also a scored negative in `camber datasets score` and the LBNL benchmark, so its false-positive rate here is in-sample, not a held-out result. The basis map below records this with each finding. G36 AFDD (0.98, #94): g36_afdd runs with FC6 enabled by the same documented minimum, min_oa_pct 1.6 (the 10% fixed damper minimum measured as an OA fraction, above). Since #94 the G36 free-cooling state needs the economizer open beyond its minimum, so the stuck-open damper runs (damper commanded to its 10% minimum, 68-100% OA delivered) are no longer read as free cooling; FC6, the G36 test for outdoor air off its minimum, reports them instead (damper_stuck_075 27.8%, damper_stuck_100_short 28.1%, fault) while the fault-free run reads 1.18% (ok). FREE COOLING MISSED (0.100, #101): free_cooling_missed runs at the documented 60 F fixed dry-bulb high limit (section 1.2, the same high_limit_f economizer_high_limit uses), reading the unit's own OA damper command (OA_DMPR_DM) and mixed-air temperature (MA_TEMP, with RA_TEMP). Hourly over 5,515 free-cooling hours (1,986 on damper_stuck_100_short): damper_stuck_010 and damper_stuck_025 49% (fault), onset_damper_stuck_025 30% (fault) and damper_stuck_075 13% (warn), all with missed_cause damper_not_delivering; damper_stuck_100_short 0% (ok). The fault-free and coi_leakage_010 runs read warn (17.5% and 18.3%, missed_cause economizer_not_commanded): 899 of the fault-free run's 965 missed hours (942 of 1,007 on the leak run) are below the 33.8 F low-limit lockout, where the sequence holds the damper at its minimum by design, and the rule has no low-limit parameter. Without those hours the fault-free run would read 1.2%. Read these two warnings as the lockout, not a fault. free_cooling_missed is not a scored target. Since #101 the RCx issue on damper_stuck_075 is headed by that cause, 'Outdoor-air damper not modulating (stuck part open)', where the root economizer_high_limit finding read 'Economizer open above the high limit'.

basis.measured_fan_heat_f: calibrated on lbnl-sdahu AHU__fault_free (median supply minus mixed air, 1.06 F over 1,400 occupied fan-on valve-shut hours); in-sample: that run is also a scored negative
basis.cool_delta_thr_f: CAMBER judgment: a cooling leak must take the supply air below the mixed air (rise < 0 F with the 1.0 F fan heat); fault-free occupied hours below it: 2.4%
basis.occupied_only: calibrated on lbnl-sdahu AHU__fault_free: unoccupied fan cycling reads 24.2% of valve-shut hours below the line, occupied hours 2.4%

basis.min_oa_pct: documented: the 10% fixed minimum damper position (inventory section 1.2), measured as a 1.6% OA fraction (median of 119,163 occupied, fan-on minutes of the fault-free run); the same value outdoor_air_fraction uses

basis.high_limit_f: documented: the fixed 60 F dry-bulb economizer high limit (inventory section 1.2); the same value economizer_high_limit uses
